steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」：本站會先複製邀請碼 JVP0PR61，再開啟發票怪獸的短網址（qmonster.spring-trees.site），之後會轉到「前往發票怪獸」頁面。
steps.en: Select “Sign up”: this site copies invite code JVP0PR61, then opens the 發票怪獸 short link (qmonster.spring-trees.site), which redirects to its 前往發票怪獸 page.

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示下載並開啟發票怪獸 App，開始註冊新帳號。
steps.en: Follow the page to download and open the 發票怪獸 app, then start registering a new account.

steps.zh-TW: 在註冊時貼上邀請碼 JVP0PR61（請依原樣輸入，含大小寫）；若 App 沒有自動帶入，請貼上或手動輸入。
steps.en: Paste invite code JVP0PR61 when you register, exactly as shown (including capitalization); if the app does not fill it in, paste or type it in.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊後可在 App 內查看怪獸幣；是否入帳、使用期限與兌換規則，以官方公告為準。
steps.en: After registering, check your monster coins in the app; crediting, validity and redemption rules follow the official announcements.

intro.zh-TW: 發票怪獸是統一發票對獎 App；註冊時輸入邀請碼 JVP0PR61。本站未找到官方公布的邀請獎勵，內容以官方公告為準。
intro.en: 發票怪獸 (Q Monster) is a Taiwan receipt-lottery app; enter invite code JVP0PR61 at sign-up. No official invite reward found; terms follow official announcements.

description.zh-TW:
發票怪獸（英文品牌為 Q Monster）是春樹科技股份有限公司推出的統一發票對獎 App，可掃描或同步發票自動對獎，並透過養怪獸的遊戲累積怪獸幣，怪獸幣可兌換平台指定的商品。App 可免費下載，另有 App 內購買項目。

點擊「立即註冊」時，本站會先複製邀請碼 JVP0PR61，再開啟發票怪獸的短網址。網址本身不含邀請碼，請在註冊時確認已帶入；若沒有，請貼上或手動輸入（請依原樣，含大小寫）。

怪獸幣不能兌換現金、不能轉讓，也有使用期限。本站沒有找到官方公布的新用戶邀請獎勵，所以不列出優惠，實際內容以官方公告為準。
description.en:
發票怪獸 (Q Monster) is a Taiwan receipt-lottery (統一發票) prize-checking app from 春樹科技股份有限公司 (Spring Trees Technology). Users scan or sync their receipts for automatic prize matching and collect monster coins (怪獸幣) through a monster-raising game, and the coins can be redeemed for goods the platform designates. The app is free to download and has optional in-app purchases.

Selecting “Sign up” first copies code JVP0PR61 and then opens the 發票怪獸 short link. The link address itself does not contain the code, so check that it has been filled in when you register; if not, paste or type it in exactly as shown, including capitalization.

Monster coins cannot be cashed out or transferred, and they expire. No official reward for new users was found, so no offer is listed here; actual terms follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW:
此連結的網址本身不含邀請碼（邀請碼在轉址後才以 invite_code 參數出現），所以本站採貼上模式。連結是發票怪獸的短網址（qmonster.spring-trees.site/FDVEgT）：2026-10-24 開啟時會轉到 monster.spring-trees.site 的「前往發票怪獸」頁面，邀請碼會以 invite_code 參數出現在轉址後的網址。這兩個主機都在 spring-trees.site 網域下，網域名稱與營運公司春樹科技的英文名稱 Spring Trees 相符；官方網站 qmonster.cc 的按鈕連到同一個服務（qmonster.spring-trees.site/2026QMP），所以本站只列入完整主機 qmonster.spring-trees.site，沒有列入整個 spring-trees.site，因為沒有找到該網域的註冊資料；該頁面上也沒有 App Store 或 Google Play 的連結。分享文案只提到註冊時輸入邀請碼，已有帳號是否能事後輸入，本站沒有找到說明。

qmonster.cc 列入官方網域的依據：App Store 頁面沒有列出開發者網站，但官網頁尾的聯絡信箱使用 spring-trees.com 這個網域，與營運公司英文名稱 Spring Trees 相符，官網的 Facebook 粉絲專頁與 App Store 頁面所列的相同，官網連結的使用者條款頁（app.qmonster.cc）署名春樹科技股份有限公司，與 App Store 賣家 Spring Trees Technology 相符，分享連結也由 App 內的分享功能產生；網域註冊資料未取得。

分享文案寫「在註冊時輸入我的好友邀請碼，一起賺怪獸幣換好禮」，沒有寫金額。官方的邀請說明頁（2023-03-30 發布，可能已過時）沒有列出新用戶的邀請獎勵，所以本站不列出優惠，也不保證可以賺到任何金額。邀請碼在註冊時是否被接受、怪獸幣是否入帳，本站沒有實際測試。

怪獸幣規則（取自 qmonster.cc 頁尾連結的使用者條款與隱私權政策，app.qmonster.cc，2026/09/17 發布）：只能兌換公司指定的商品，不能兌換現金、不能轉讓；使用期限為會員同意授權日起 6 個月，每次重新同意可再加 6 個月；公司可隨時取消怪獸幣。App Store 頁面連結的是另一份較舊、未標日期的隱私權政策，兩份內容可能不同，以 App 內顯示為準。官方邀請說明頁（2023 年）另提到被邀請者綁定 90 天、不能中途解綁，現行規則以官方公告為準。

App Store 年齡分級為 13+；依官方條款，未成年人須經法定代理人閱讀並同意後才可使用會員服務。App 可免費下載，有 App 內購買項目，請不要為了邀請碼而購買。發票怪獸是春樹科技推出的民營 App，不是財政部的統一發票兌獎 App；使用時會處理個人的發票與載具資料，請先閱讀官方隱私權政策。

短網址的終點可由擁有者變更，請在繼續前確認最終網址。
notes.en:
The URL itself does not contain the invite code (it appears as the invite_code parameter only after the redirect), so this site uses paste mode. The link is a short URL (qmonster.spring-trees.site/FDVEgT): when opened on 2026-10-24 it redirected to the 前往發票怪獸 page on monster.spring-trees.site, where the invite code appears in the address as the invite_code parameter. Both hosts are under the spring-trees.site domain, whose name matches the English name of the operator 春樹科技, Spring Trees. The official site qmonster.cc links its buttons to the same service (qmonster.spring-trees.site/2026QMP), so only the full host qmonster.spring-trees.site is listed here, not the whole spring-trees.site domain, because no registration record for that domain was found; that page shows no App Store or Google Play links. The share text mentions entering the code only at registration; no explanation was found of whether an existing account can enter a code later.

Why qmonster.cc is listed as an official domain: the App Store page lists no developer website, but the contact address in the site footer uses the spring-trees.com domain, which matches the company's English name, the site's Facebook page is the same one linked from the App Store listing, the user terms page linked from the site (app.qmonster.cc) names 春樹科技股份有限公司, which matches the App Store seller Spring Trees Technology CO., LTD., and the share link is produced by the app's own share function. No domain registration records were obtained.

The share text says to enter the friend invite code when you register and earn monster coins together for gifts, and gives no amount. The official invite explainer (published 2023-03-30, possibly outdated) lists no reward for new users, so no offer is listed here and no amount is promised. Whether the code is accepted at sign-up and whether coins are credited was not tested.

Monster coin rules (from the user terms and privacy policy linked in the qmonster.cc footer, on app.qmonster.cc, published 2026/09/17): coins can only be redeemed for goods the company designates and cannot be cashed out or transferred; they are valid for 6 months from the date of the member's data-authorization consent (extended by 6 months each time the member consents again), and the company may cancel them at any time. The App Store listing links a different, older and undated privacy policy, so the two documents may differ; follow what the app shows. The official invite explainer (2023) also mentions a 90-day binding of the invited friend that cannot be undone early; current rules follow the official announcements.

The App Store age rating is 13+, and under the official terms a minor needs a legal guardian to read and agree before using member services. The app is free to download and has in-app purchases; do not buy anything because of an invite code. 發票怪獸 is a private app by Spring Trees Technology, not the Ministry of Finance's own invoice-claiming app, and it handles your personal invoice and carrier data, so read the official privacy policy first.

The destination of a short link can be changed by its owner, so check the final address before continuing.

q.zh-TW: 發票怪獸的邀請碼 JVP0PR61 要輸入在哪裡？
q.en: Where do I enter 發票怪獸 invite code JVP0PR61?

a.zh-TW: 依分享文案，請在註冊時輸入這組邀請碼。依 App Store 4.3.0 的更新紀錄，透過連結安裝可自動帶入邀請碼，沒有帶入時請貼上或手動輸入，並依原樣（含大小寫）輸入。官方沒有公開說明輸入邀請碼的確切畫面，請以 App 內顯示為準。
a.en: Per the share text, enter the code when you sign up. The App Store release notes for 4.3.0 say that installing through a link fills the code in automatically; if it is not filled in, paste it or type it in exactly as shown, including capitalization. The official pages do not describe the exact entry screen, so follow what the app shows.

q.zh-TW: 輸入發票怪獸邀請碼可以得到多少怪獸幣？
q.en: How many monster coins does a 發票怪獸 invite code give?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案沒有寫出數量，本站也沒有找到官方頁面公布新用戶的邀請獎勵，所以本頁不列出金額或優惠。官方的邀請說明頁（2023-03-30 發布，可能已過時）提到，被邀請者自己的怪獸幣不會因此減少，邀請人則可從被邀請者掃描發票獲得怪獸幣。實際內容以官方公告為準。
a.en: The share text gives no number, and no official page was found that states a reward for new users, so this page lists no amount or offer. The official invite explainer (published 2023-03-30, possibly outdated) says the invited friend's own coins are not reduced, and that the inviter earns coins from the friend's receipt scans. Actual terms follow the official announcements.
